# DevEx Calculator

> Independent calculator and reference for Roblox creators estimating a
> Developer Exchange (DevEx) payout from eligible Earned Robux.

Canonical URL: https://devexcalculator.org/

## What this site is

DevExCalculator.org converts eligible Earned Robux into an estimated US dollar
DevEx payout using the rates Roblox currently documents, and explains the
eligibility rules around that conversion. Every rate-sensitive figure carries a
citation to official Roblox documentation and the date it was last checked.

## Not affiliated with Roblox

This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or operated by
Roblox Corporation. Roblox, Robux and Developer Exchange are trademarks of
Roblox Corporation, used here only to describe the subject of the
calculations. This site cannot determine whether any DevEx request will be
approved.

## Calculators

- https://devexcalculator.org/ — DevEx calculator: Earned Robux to USD
- https://devexcalculator.org/robux-to-usd/ — Robux to USD, creator payout vs purchase price
- https://devexcalculator.org/usd-to-robux/ — Earned Robux needed for a payout target
- https://devexcalculator.org/robux-tax-calculator/ — Roblox marketplace fee calculator
- https://devexcalculator.org/conversions/ — Conversions for common amounts

## Reference

- https://devexcalculator.org/devex-rates/ — Current, legacy and conditional U.S. 18+ rates
- https://devexcalculator.org/devex-requirements/ — Minimum and eligibility requirements
- https://devexcalculator.org/earned-robux/ — What counts as Earned Robux
- https://devexcalculator.org/how-to-cash-out-robux/ — The cash-out process
- https://devexcalculator.org/devex-rate-history/ — Rate change history
- https://devexcalculator.org/devex-fees-and-taxes/ — Fees and taxes after a payout

## Methodology and sources

- https://devexcalculator.org/methodology/ — Formulas, exact arithmetic, rounding policy
- https://devexcalculator.org/sources/ — Every source with its verification date
- https://devexcalculator.org/editorial-policy/ — Sourcing and publication standards
- https://devexcalculator.org/corrections/ — How to report an error
- https://devexcalculator.org/changelog/ — Dated record of rate and content changes

## Machine-readable data

- https://devexcalculator.org/api/rates — Current rate registry with sources, as JSON
- https://devexcalculator.org/sitemap.xml — Every canonical indexable URL

## Using this content

Facts on this site come from Roblox's own documentation and are cited as such;
please cite Roblox directly for those. If you quote this site's explanations or
calculations, attribute them to DevExCalculator.org and link to the page. Always
check the "verified" date before republishing a rate — rates change, and a
figure quoted without its date becomes wrong without warning.
